description: Mostly a move-count detector: fires late in the game when exactly 27 stones are on the board (also 25, 29, 31, 33 less often), provided columns 3-4 hold many stones and columns 0-1 few; a last move in column 4 or 6 helps, in 0, 3 or 5 hurts. Separately fires at 4 stones when the last move was column 5. Even move counts essentially never fire.
effect: None measurable: forcing it to max or zero changes move probabilities by <0.01 on 3 positions.
notes: Layer-0 unit, tiny activations (dev max 0.008). Ply alone: F1 0.32. Adding column-count score (h3+h4-h0-h1) with last-col and ply-specific offsets: F1 0.556-0.575 (best p6: P 0.60, R 0.56, AUROC 0.77). Weighted variants with more columns scored worse (0.51). Single-move substitutions change activation <=0.002: it reads aggregate column frequencies of the move sequence, not a tactical pattern. Second player's moves in col 5 raise it at ply 27. Synthesis reaches 0.008 (=dev max) legally; 0.009 variants complete a four. Looks like positional/token-statistics feature, possibly a random direction.
